repository.name: webex
repository.purpose: The webex npm package of the Webex JS SDK. Its entry files require plugin packages for their side effects and extend the webex-core WebexCore constructor, giving a full Webex constructor (main export), a meetings constructor (webex/meetings), a Calling wrapper around an SDK instance (webex/calling), and encryption and first-party variants. It also selects storage adapters per platform, ships Node and browser helper files, and carries committed UMD bundles.

glossary.definition: A file in src/ that loads a plugin set and defines a Webex constructor (webex.js, meetings.js, encryption.js, calling.js) or re-exports one (index.js, webex-first-party.js).
Requiring a plugin package registers its plugin on the webex-core registry; the entry file uses no binding from it.
glossary.notes: First registration of a name wins unless the plugin passes replace, per loaded webex-core copy (module spec INV-002).

glossary.definition: Config value set by each init: webex, meetings, or encryption.
glossary.notes: Not set by new Webex or by Calling.

evidence_rules.requirement: The script must exist in package.json scripts.
A subpath is importable only if it is in the exports map.
evidence_rules.notes: env.js, browser.js, src/encryption.js, and src/webex-first-party.js are shipped but not exported.

evidence_rules.requirement: Ground every behavioral claim in source or test evidence; route runtime behavior to the owning plugin or webex-core.
evidence_rules.notes: Commit history is not an evidence source. README.md is retained product documentation, not the behavioral authority.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not assume src/config.js values reach the instance.
negative_guidance.why: The entry files read its ES default export with require, so the values land under config.default.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not call Calling#deregister without a calling client.
negative_guidance.why: Object.values of an undefined getLines result throws a TypeError.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not import webex/env or src/encryption.js by subpath.
negative_guidance.why: Neither is in the exports map.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not edit umd/ by hand.
negative_guidance.why: It is output of the workspace root webpack build.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not infer a coverage threshold for this package.
negative_guidance.why: The developer confirmed no coverage gate applies; jest-config-legacy sets collectCoverage false.

high.expectation: Source and a unit or integration test both support the change: instance version, init merge, commonjs loading, and the user-agent prefix.

medium.expectation: Only source evidence exists, for example meetings, encryption, first-party, Calling, storage, and env.js (its integration spec requires the unexported webex/env subpath). Pin current behavior with a test before modifying.

low.expectation: The behavior belongs to webex-core or a plugin package. Stop and route to that package.
